tests.name: Known-broken: truncate an artifact while leaving its sentinel
Known-broken: complete an artifact without its sentinel
Both-states: a healthy pair must pass silently
Sentinel matches SUCCESS:<unit-id> exactly; near-miss does not count

negative_controls.description: Truncate a healthy JSON artifact, leave SUCCESS:FIX-0001 in place, and require Direction A.
Write a complete JSON artifact with the exact sentinel removed and require Direction B (spec 11313 class).
Five near-miss strings (suffix, wrong-id, missing-letter, space-not-colon, case-fold) must not satisfy C5.
negative_controls.good_state_output: exact SUCCESS:FIX-0001 is a bounded token

reviewer.notes: Reviewer requirement: plant one fault in each direction. Probe 2 re-runs the plants independently of emit and re-derives live Direction A/B counts from disk. Plants are recorded in report.plants because reviewer additionalProperties is false.

retry.policy: Two strikes then pivot: after the 2nd failure on the same error-fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative implementations before a 3rd attempt (AGENTS.md 4b).
pivot_alternatives: Load physical schemas into jsonschema 4.10 RefResolver store

residual_unknowns.claim: C6-C12 of the 12-condition completion predicate are NOT-CHECKED on the live corpus. platform/lib/completion_predicate.py, COMPLETION-GATES.json, and the CNF-0162 reducer-as-shipped may be absent or incomplete on this worktree; claiming them would be an overclaim.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Run the shipped completion_predicate reducer over every present catalog output_path once COMPLETION-GATES.json and the CNF-0162 receipt-to-disk verifier are both live.

report.question: Question: does every artifact carrying a completion sentinel actually satisfy the completion predicate, AND does every complete artifact carry its sentinel? Spec:11313 names 'partial artifact without sentinel' as a required failure class; the inverse - a sentinel on a partial artifact - is the more dangerous direction because it manufactures a pass. Audit both.
report.title: Sentinel-versus-completeness audit in both directions
report.min_bytes_rationale: 200 bytes is the ready_units.py text-body floor (about two sentences) and the CNF-0162 meaningful-size requirement. A 0-byte file is the MSYS truncation signature; a sentinel-only file is a manufactured pass. Mutation: lowering the floor to 1 would admit the truncated-with-sentinel control as complete-minus-sentinel.

completeness_minus_sentinel.why_not_checked: platform/lib/completion_predicate.py, COMPLETION-GATES.json, and a shipped CNF-0162 reducer may be absent. Claiming C6-C12 on the live corpus would be an overclaim. Fixture controls still prove both sentinel directions against P.
